evidence.missing_history_diagnosis: The legacy exporter only discovers histories through persisted review reports. The clean1 report was not originally written, so its 44 real archived-before rows are omitted. The current explicit revalidation registration does not forge that historical report.
evidence.quote_diagnosis: Six facts from three clean2 groups carry recorded unique source-ID/whitespace alignments. The unchanged legacy checker requires unchanged quote text/ID. V2 checks the original actual request/output, uniqueness, exact source substring and Unicode offsets independently.

post_processing_efficiency_diagnosis.finding: After successful processing the main agent used five additional model turns, six SQL-style financial queries and one local FTS evidence search to inspect lease maturities, subsidy boundaries, revenue dimensions and a quarter. One revenue query used offset 8 against total 7 and returned no rows. The run did not rerun ingestion, period cleaning, charts or valuation.
post_processing_efficiency_diagnosis.input_context_finding: Each main turn carried roughly 212k to 251k input tokens, mostly historical context. Cache reads lower billing but not context size or benchmark input accounting. This run proves finite partial-batch continuation, not efficient end-to-end context use.
post_processing_efficiency_diagnosis.followup: Optimize tool-result projection and stop behavior separately after the currently running frozen evaluation. Do not silently alter this run or make an A/B improvement claim.

limitations: Only 90 targeted financial-definition facts were semantically reviewed; 3298-row preservation is not a statement that every original row was extracted correctly.
The 15 anchors and 9 distinctions are previously known development regressions, not new-company holdout.
The old failed reports and old scorer outputs remain failed and byte-preserved.
No new model, network search, database write, cancellation or application lifecycle action was performed by this audit.
